79577.subject: Vitalik Backs a Prediction Market and TRUE Jumps 900%
79577.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[Vitalik Buterin](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/vitalik-buterin-backs-trueo-ethereum-move-true-jumps-900)**[ backed Trueo's move to Ethereum mainnet and TRUE jumped 900%](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/vitalik-buterin-backs-trueo-ethereum-move-true-jumps-900)

* **[Binance](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/binance-100-million-circle-stake-five-year-usdc-deal)**[ took a $100 million Circle stake and renewed the USDC deal Circle pays for](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/binance-100-million-circle-stake-five-year-usdc-deal)

* **[Kalshi](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/kalshi-denies-faking-its-crypto-volume)**[ blamed one paid market maker for the repeating trade size in its ether perp](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/kalshi-denies-faking-its-crypto-volume)

* **[a16z and the DeFi Education Fund](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/a16z-defi-education-fund-sec-dex-exchange-registration-safe-harbor)**[ asked the SEC to put DEXs outside exchange registration](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/a16z-defi-education-fund-sec-dex-exchange-registration-safe-harbor)

* **[Bitcoin Cash](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-cash-cme-futures-listing-sep-22-2026)**[ ran 27% on CME's futures listing as bitcoin gave up the day](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-cash-cme-futures-listing-sep-22-2026)

Vitalik Buterin posted about Trueo 78 minutes after the protocol said it would move its primary deployment from Base to Ethereum mainnet, calling it dedicated to decentralization and "ethical and not corposlop." TRUE traded at $0.1786, up 900% over 24 hours, on $11.9 million of volume against a $16.6 million market value. The price moved on the post. The deployment has not: Trueo holds $847,526 in total value locked, all of it still on Base, and [has set no migration date](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/vitalik-buterin-backs-trueo-ethereum-move-true-jumps-900).

What mainnet would be getting is small. Ethereum has another upstart prediction market called Seer, which runs on Gnosis Chain and Ethereum and which DefiLlama has tracked since October 2024. Seer holds $314,773 across the two chains, $31,013 of it on Ethereum. Trueo would arrive at roughly 27 times the size of the deployment already there, and still under $1 million.

[Augur](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/augur-reveals-augur-lituus-oracle-whitepaper) shows what that ceiling has looked like. It launched in 2018 as the first onchain prediction market, runs on Ethereum alone, and holds $2.16 million, the largest of any prediction market on mainnet, against $342 million at Polymarket International on Polygon. Kalshi keeps no onchain footprint at all. Eight years of mainnet and Ethereum's biggest prediction market is worth less than 1% of Polymarket's. Liquidity was the constraint, and an endorsement doesn't move it.

**Read more below!**

79572.subject: 🟪 When the thesis plays out
79572.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/9f199753-ca31-4e3d-9435-5e12896ecff5/BD_NL_Banner_Heading.png?t=1781793903)
Caption: 

# The price is the product

Crypto’s reflexivity never ceases to amaze me. Price rises, the protocol captures attention, new users try the product, and fundamentals improve, reinforcing the narrative that attracted everyone in the first place. Derive is the latest example.

Last week, a few prominent voices on X [argued](https://x.com/tulipking/status/2100051477033071048?s=20) that Derive remained undervalued, while traders shared screenshots of OTM positions [executed](https://x.com/koolkrypto223/status/2099141525850747001?s=20) on the platform. The resulting attention helped drive a more than 170% rally in DRV last week and drew more traders to the product, contributing to an all-time high of $1.26B in weekly options volume. Through Sept. 20, monthly options volume had already reached $2.37B, 24% above the previous record with 10 days still remaining.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/fd206938-c856-4ca8-a624-39a3513881f5/image.png?t=1790099434)
Caption: 

To assess whether higher volume was accompanied by broader participation, we looked at daily active traders and the number of options trades. Derive averaged 459 daily traders last week, up 68% week over week and the highest full-week average since February 2025. Options trade count increased 83% to nearly 11,800.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eeaa5633-d7a3-43a2-84e0-00c652ad470a/image.png?t=1790099434)
Caption: 

ETH reclaimed its position as Derive’s largest options market after an extended period of BTC-led activity, generating $632M in weekly volume versus $520M for BTC. Activity also continued to expand beyond the two majors, with HYPE contributing $58M and ZEC reaching $37M, nearly four times its prior week’s volume. ZEC traded throughout all seven days, while both trade count and average trade size increased sharply.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/e91ae9f3-89dc-4598-a2c1-3e2ff6ed821f/image.png?t=1790099431)
Caption: 

The increase in activity was accompanied by greater demand for upside convexity. ETH traders bought roughly $95M of outright OTM calls measured by underlying notional, including sizable exposure to $4,000-$5,000 strikes for 2027, although some of the largest prints formed part of structured call spreads. ZEC offered an even clearer example of speculative positioning, with traders buying calls struck as much as 145% above spot.
